question: Use this complete-assembly observation and its stated uncertainty and adjustment limits. What is the next mass correction? No density or recipe is available.

result.answer: Proposed: add ~0.05 kg (required range 0.04 to 0.06 kg) to trial-1. Why: observed 0.95±0.005 kg (0.945-0.955 kg) is below target 0.98-1.02 kg, and computation shows this addition brings simulated mass to 0.99-1.01 kg within limits and within 0.1 kg add limit. Fixed: no recipe/density change, no volume claim. Next: reweigh closed assembly and separately verify occupied volume/adjustment space.
